items.title: Chelsea suffer defeat to Juventus in lacklustre Hong Kong friendly
items.description: Chelsea failed to ramp up their pre-season preparations as Xabi Alonso's side suffered a 1-0 defeat to Juventus in Hong Kong thanks to Edon Zhegrova's stunning second-half strike.

items.title: Boxer Chapman undergoes emergency surgery after collapsing in training
items.description: British boxer Raven Chapman underwent emergency surgery for a bleed on her brain after collapsing following a sparring session in Denmark.

items.title: Why Arsenal are signing Newcastle captain Guimaraes
items.description: With Bruno Guimaraes set to sign for Premier League champions Arsenal, BBC Sport look at why the Gunners wanted the Newcastle skipper.

items.title: Cardiff set to sign Lincoln midfielder Moylan
items.description: Lincoln City midfielder Jack Moylan is poised to join Championship rivals Cardiff City after an impressive last season in League One.

items.title: 'Shark' De Zerbi hopes to drag Spurs up from the depths
items.description: Through his self-confessed love of the transfer window, Tottenham boss Roberto de Zerbi hopes he can guide his club back up the Premier League table.

items.title: Salah given hero's welcome before Trabzonspor move
items.description: Turkish club Trabzonspor are set to confirm the signing of Egypt captain and former Liverpool forward Mohamed Salah.

items.title: Liverpool explore deal for PSG winger Mbaye
items.description: Liverpool have explored the conditions of a deal for Paris Saint-Germain's teenage winger Ibrahim Mbaye.

items.title: Hull sign goalkeeper Tzolakis for club record fee
items.description: Hull City sign Greece goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis from Olympiacos on a five-year deal for a club-record fee.

items.description: Chelsea are set to clinch a deal to sign Rayo Vallecano left-back Pep Chavarria for a fee of around £16.3m (€19m) plus add-ons.

items.title: Salah set to join Turkish side Trabzonspor
items.description: Mohamed Salah is set to join Turkish side Trabzonspor on a free transfer after mutually agreeing to terminate his Liverpool contract a year early.
